description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named ShippingOptionsController that manages shipping options in an e-commerce admin interface. It includes endpoints for displaying and saving shipping configurations, interacts with shipping services, handles form data, and manages view rendering.

classes.name: ShippingOptionsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller responsible for displaying and updating shipping options in the admin panel of an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: displayShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current shipping options, retrieves configuration, and prepares the model for view rendering.

methods.name: saveShippingOptions
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save changes to shipping options, validating and updating the shipping configuration accordingly.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set the active menu in the model for UI navigation.
